witness.quote: Where the signal is a green turn arrow alone:
witness.reason: Route travel at an intersection can include highway entry while facing the specified signal.
required_context: Ego is a person afoot traveling from outside the highway toward entry.
Establish arrow representation, direction, indications and governed routes; travel does not independently specify a turn or straight movement.
Establish highway boundary lines, public dedication and openness to public vehicular traffic; do not substitute the roadway edge.
Identify arrow direction, official status, facing geometry, governed vehicle route and display timing.
Inventory other potentially permissive devices and their states; preserve NRS 484B.283 and its four supplied reference IDs without inferring their contents.
Preserve separate pedestrian-device scope and identify other-device states and timing.
Specify a person-afoot route beginning outside the full highway extent and approaching entry.
witness.subject_reason: The cell explicitly supplies a pedestrian variant compatible with the obligation.
